en: A painted illustration of a man standing and playing a traditional string instrument resembling a kora, made from a large calabash gourd with a long neck. The man wears a light-colored hat, loose greenish tunic, wide brown trousers, socks and black shoes. Colored ribbons hang from the instrument. The background is plain and neutral, with no scenery or text besides the artwork itself.
